answer: Duplicate identities split influence across the river of reputation, so a fake cluster must fund every copy, raising attacker cost linearly. Sybil resistance can work through a staked identity harbor: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest only to work anchored to that bond. Slashed bonds from failed attestations push the horizon of profitable forgery beyond reach, making mass impersonation economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
